info.title: Order and Payment Management API
info.description: Authenticate with a JWT bearer token. API errors use message/code and validation errors include errors. Limits are configurable; 429 includes Retry-After. Payment creation in a later sprint will require Idempotency-Key; replays count toward rate limits.

post.description: Email is trimmed and normalized to lowercase. Returns the user; log in separately to obtain a JWT.

post.summary: Log in and obtain a JWT
post.description: Limited by normalized email and IP address. expires_in is seconds. Send access_token as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
The token is blacklisted until its expiry. Returns an empty response.

get.description: Owner-scoped and read-only. Entries are ordered by chain_sequence. Credits add to balance, debits subtract, memos have no balance effect. Payment-scoped history is introduced with Payments in Sprint 4.
Owner-scoped, newest first. per_page defaults to 15 and has a maximum of 100.

post.description: Totals and initial pending status are computed by the aggregate. Client total_amount, status, and user_id fields are ignored.

get.description: Other users receive 404, matching missing resources.

put.description: Only pending orders are editable. Provided items replace the entire item collection; omitted fields remain unchanged.

value.message: An order with payments cannot be deleted.
Cannot change order status from cancelled to confirmed.

delete.description: Any existing payment, including failed attempts, blocks deletion. Until Payments is implemented, a temporary no-payments guard is bound.

204.description: Order and its items deleted; no response body.

value.message: An order with payments cannot be deleted.
Cannot change order status from cancelled to confirmed.

patch.description: Only pending orders are editable. Provided items replace the complete item collection.

value.message: An order with payments cannot be deleted.
Cannot change order status from cancelled to confirmed.

patch.description: Allowed transitions: pending to confirmed/cancelled; confirmed to cancelled only without successful payment. Cancelled is terminal.

value.message: An order with payments cannot be deleted.
Cannot change order status from cancelled to confirmed.

get.description: Public when API_DOCUMENTATION_ENABLED is true. Disabled in production by default. Documentation assets and spec downloads use the same flag and IP rate limiter.

password.description: At least 8 characters including letters and numbers; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes (bcrypt limit).

price.description: Non-negative decimal string; at most two decimal places and DECIMAL(12,2) capacity.

message.example: Authentication is required or the token is invalid.

Unauthenticated.description: Authentication is missing or the token is invalid or expired.

value.message: Authentication is required or the token is invalid.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user is not allowed to perform this action.

value.message: You are not allowed to perform this action.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to this user.

value.message: The requested resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the resource state.

value.message: The request conflicts with the current resource state.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after the indicated delay.

value.message: Too many requests. Please try again later.

ServerError.description: Unexpected error. Internal details are never exposed.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key, preferably a UUID, 8–255 characters. Completed identical requests replay status/body with Idempotent-Replayed: true; in-progress requests return 409 with Retry-After: 1; mismatches return 422. Default TTL 24 hours. Validation and server errors release the key.
